newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: PRESS DIGEST - Saudi Arabia - Sept 24.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Saudi Arabia - Sept 24.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Saudi Arabian press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Saudi investment funds finance 266 projects in Egypt.
- Saudi Arabian industrial exports exceeded 15 billion riyals in 1995. There are 2,500 factories in the kingdom with total investment of 151 billion riyals.
- World leaders greet King Fahd on Saudi national day.

- Saudi authorities reject 400 tonnes of British fodder imported by a Saudi company. An agriculture ministry source said the shipment certificate said the fodder was made of grass but analysis showed otherwise.

- Last round of talks between EgyptAir and Saudi Arabian Airlines will be held in Cairo next month to reach an agreement and renew the existing one. The Saudi flag carrier has been given the green light for the first time to operate flights from Dhahran to Egyptian ports. EgyptAir had demanded permission to fly to the Saudi holy city of Medina.
